english.note: Use this especially when redoing a piece of work, assignment, or task, often because the first version was unsatisfactory.

examples.english: There were too many mistakes in the homework, so the teacher told me to redo it.
examples.traditional: 份功課錯咗咁多，老師叫我重做。
